description: Search the research papers and trial registrations behind the Peptides Academy dossiers by topic, peptide, author or journal, for questions like "what studies looked at BPC-157 and tendon healing" or "semaglutide cardiovascular outcomes". Each hit gives the citation, DOI, PubMed or ClinicalTrials.gov link, the courses whose research uses it, and what our dossier says about it with short verbatim quotes, numbered as sources. It never returns full texts or abstracts.

limit.description: How many papers to return, 1 to 10. Default 5.

peptide.description: Optional peptide id or name to limit results to papers behind that course, for example "bpc157" or "Ozempic".

query.description: Topic, finding, author or journal to search for, for example "BPC-157 tendon" or "semaglutide cardiovascular".

name: search_papers
title: Search research papers
